item.title: Former MEP Brian Cowley described as "inspirational figure"
item.description: Former MEP Brian Crowley who's died is being described as "an inspirational figure." He passed away yesterday at the age of 61 after spending 25 years as a member of the European Parliament. He stepped away from politics in 2019. Cork North West TD and Junior Education Minister Michael Moynihan is devastated at his passing: Advertisement

item.title: Local TD reflects on one year anniversary of Storm Éowyn
item.description: The devastation from Storm Éowyn is still being felt on its one year anniversary today. Over eight hundred thousand homes were left without power and over one hundred thousand without water. Cavan Monaghan Fianna Fail TD Brendan Smith says the electricity grid needs to have greater resilience and telecom providers must also strengthen their networks. Deputy Smith says locals are still worried about steps that need to be taken a year on: Advertisement

item.title: Bluetongue detected in an animal in Wexford
item.description: Bluetongue has been detected in an animal in Co Wexford. The Minister for Agriculture, Food and the Marine, Martin Heydon, confirmed the outbreak, saying the news is unwelcome but not surprising as the virus has been spreading across Europe, Britain and Northern Ireland. The outbreak will have an impact on exports of cattle and sheep, with additional costs required in order to comply with the rules of the countries of destination. item.title: Referral of Mercosur deal to European Court a "victory for common sense"
item.description: The decision to send the Mercosur trade deal to the European Court of Justice for review has been described locally as a "victory for common sense." Earlier this week the European Parliament voted to refer the EU-Mercosur trade agreement to the European Court. The closely contested vote in Strasbourg will now significantly delay the agreement and place its legal foundations under formal scrutiny by the Court. item.title: Water supplies in place following burst water main in Ballyjamesduff
item.description: Uisce Éireann crews continue to work to repair a burst water main outside Ballyjamesduff this morning. Repairs are continuing to prove complex with ongoing difficulty gaining access to the burst water main on the Virginia Road leading out of the town. It's being reported that customers in Ballyjamesduff may be experiencing intermittent water supply or reduced pressure. item.title: Woman highlights positive benefits of naturism
item.description: A woman has highlighted how naturism has had a positive impact on her self-confidence.
